title: One released judge vote
description: Line format of datasets/<dataset_id>/votes/<arm>/<judge_key>.jsonl. One JSON object per line, no trailing commas, UTF-8. Raw model responses, reasoning traces and prompts are never included.

uid.description: Item id in the source dataset; the join key.

label.description: The judge's final label, from the dataset manifest's task.labels.

parse_fail.description: true = no legal label could be read from the reply, so `label` is a deterministic placeholder hash of uid:judge_key, NOT a judgment. Filter these items out unless you are reproducing the paper's retained-placeholder table.

variant.description: 0 = the baseline option order. One line per (uid, variant).

perm.description: The option permutation actually presented; the answer is mapped back, so labels are comparable in label semantics to the baseline arm.

x-notes: Baseline and presentation variant=0 are separate response snapshots. They must not be silently merged or substituted for one another.
Score-only datasets (release_tier = score_only) do not use this format; their records live in a single JSON described by the dataset manifest's arms.baseline.record_fields.
